entries.failureMode: Adapter binary not found on PATH
entries.effect: Language component analysis silently skipped; safety defects in that language undetected.
entries.cause: Missing tool installation or PATH misconfiguration in CI environment.
mitigations: fusaops adapters — lists adapter availability before analysis
CI gate fails when a required adapter is absent
fusaops sci — inventories tool presence with version and hash
entries.action: Add adapter availability check to the CI gate; fail the build on missing required adapters.

entries.function: Run x-FuSa tool and collect findings
entries.item: cmdAdapter.Run x-FuSa tool and collect findings
entries.failureMode: Adapter process exits with non-zero code
entries.effect: Findings from that language component dropped from the aggregate report.
entries.cause: Tool bug, memory exhaustion, or malformed source input.
mitigations: Adapter exit code propagated as orchestrator error
Orchestrator records skipped and failed adapters in the aggregate report
fusaops qualify — validates adapter health against each subcommand
entries.action: Surface adapter error prominently in aggregate report; treat adapter failure as a gate failure.

entries.function: Parse adapter JSON output per x-FuSa spec
entries.item: Report decoder.Parse adapter JSON output per x-FuSa spec
entries.failureMode: Adapter output schema does not conform to x-FuSa spec
entries.effect: Findings silently dropped or aggregate report mis-renders.
entries.cause: Tool version skew between adapter binary and FuSaOps decoder expectations.
mitigations: fusaops conform — schema conformance checks against the x-FuSa spec
fusaops qualify — validates adapter output against each spec section
SpecVersion pinning in capabilities response
entries.action: Run fusaops conform in CI after every tool version update; pin tool versions in Dockerfile.

entries.effect: Requirement appears untraceable; false coverage gap reported.
entries.cause: Developer removes or typos a //fusa:req annotation during refactoring.
mitigations: go-FuSa selfcheck catches annotation errors in Go source
CI gate fails on untraced requirements
fusaops trace report flags coverage gaps
entries.action: Install fusaops hooks pre-commit hook to validate annotation format before every commit.

entries.function: Merge per-language SBOMs into cross-language SBOM
entries.item: sbom package.Merge per-language SBOMs into cross-language SBOM
entries.failureMode: Language SBOM file missing from merge input
entries.effect: Component not included in final SBOM; unknown dependency risk reaches certification.
entries.cause: Adapter SBOM generation failed silently or output file not written.
mitigations: fusaops sbom warns on missing per-language SBOM inputs
fusaops sci checks SBOM artefact presence with file hash
Audit pack includes all SBOM artefacts for reviewer verification
entries.action: Add SBOM completeness check to the release gate; fail release if any language SBOM is absent.

entries.item: auditpack / sign packages.Verify integrity of evidence artefacts
entries.effect: Tampered evidence passes a manual inspection that does not re-verify the HMAC.
entries.cause: Post-sign file modification (intentional or accidental) or disk corruption.
mitigations: fusaops sign — HMAC-SHA256 verification step re-verifies before submission
fusaops audit-pack — includes hash manifest with all artefact digests
Release gate re-verifies all signatures before generating provenance
entries.action: Mandate fusaops sign --verify as the final step of the release pipeline before submission.

entries.item: cmdAdapter / orchestrator.Execute adapter within configured timeout
entries.effect: Analysis pipeline blocked; no findings produced; release delayed or silently skipped.
entries.cause: Deadlock in adapter tool, infinite loop, or unavailable external resource.
mitigations: Adapter process killed after configurable per-adapter timeout
Orchestrator records the skipped component with reason in the aggregate report
CI wall-clock timeout surfaces the failure as a build error
entries.action: Set per-adapter timeout in .fusaops.json; raise alert in report when timeout fires.

entries.function: Filter findings against the suppression list
entries.item: suppression package.Filter findings against the suppression list
entries.failureMode: Overly broad suppression rule hides new violations
entries.effect: New safety violations match an existing suppression entry and are never reviewed.
entries.cause: Wildcard or unlimited-duration suppression entry in .fusaops-suppress.json.
mitigations: fusaops suppress requires explicit rule IDs; no glob wildcards
PR review required for all changes to .fusaops-suppress.json
fusaops qualify audits active suppressions for expiry compliance
entries.action: Enforce suppression expiry dates; alert in CI when expired suppressions are still active.
